newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Av. yield on Cyprus repo auction rises to 4.87pct.
newsitem.headline: Av. yield on Cyprus repo auction rises to 4.87pct.

text.p: The average yield on a treasury bill auction held under a repurchase agreement between the Central Bank of Cyprus and commercial banks was 4.87 percent on Friday, up from 4.52 percent at the last auction held on June 13, the bank said.
Yields on the 63 million pounds worth ($123 million) of bills sold ranged from 4.71 percent to 5.21 percent. Bids for bills totalled 92.6 million pounds. ($=0.511 pounds)
